name: Hamoudi Mosque
subtitle: A mosque in central Djibouti City that EBSCO calls the nation's largest.

parts.text: A mosque in central Djibouti City that EBSCO calls the nation's largest. A heritage listing gives its construction as 1906 by Haji Hamoudi.
